## Release control

- [ ] Scope is limited to the approved change; no secrets or private records added.
- [ ] Findings were verified; unresolved risks are stated.
- [ ] Rollback / recovery is documented when relevant.
- [ ] Rick explicitly approved merge / release, or this is still awaiting approval.
